serviceArea.heading: Bergenfield, and everywhere near it
serviceArea.intro: The shop is on North Street. Most customers drive the part over — it is usually quicker than waiting for someone to come to you.
serviceArea.note: Towns beyond Bergenfield are the surrounding area we would expect to serve — confirm the list with the shop before publishing. [verify with client]

items.a: No. The shop is open Monday to Friday, 7am to 4pm. Bring the part in and we will look at it while you wait.

items.q: Can you quote from a photo?
items.a: Usually, yes. Send a photo of the part with something next to it for scale and we will tell you what it takes and roughly what it costs.

items.q: How long does a repair take?
items.a: Small repairs are often done while you wait. Fabrication work depends on the piece — we will give you a time before we start, not after.
You will know before any work begins. We agree the price up front rather than quoting after the fact.

items.q: Can you make a part I only have a sample of?
items.a: Yes. A sample, a sketch or a mock-up is enough to work from. Bring whatever you have.
